topic.title: Updating IBM BAMOE Developer Tools for VS Code

body.p: The IBM BAMOE Developer Tools for VS Code will automatically update as long as you have set this option in VS Code.

To set this option, go to Visual Studio Code, click Extensions and then select the IBM BAMOE Developer Tools for VS Code. You will see a checkbox 'Auto Update' on the page. Click it to set. This will take care of your updates automatically. To know more about IBM BAMOE Developer Tools for VS Code, see Developer Tools for VS Code.

note.p: After upgrading, the New DMN Editor will be opened automatically when you first access it in Canvas or Developer tools for VS Code. Existing DMN files (any version) can be opened directly in the editor. For more information, see Authoring decisions.
